تهتلكوا (form VIII)
# تَهْتَلِكُوا (tahtalikū) /tah.ta.li.kuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# تُهْتَلَكُوا (tuhtalakū) /tuh.ta.la.kuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
